review_note: complete-existing-instrumental-intro-excerpt-with-explicit-endpoint Selected HeYu/LiuQi/XiaoYeZi F-major printed128-BPM edition; same-title different song sources explicitly excluded. Every source pitch and original note/rest event is individually accounted. No transposition, pitch replacement, omission, or source-note merge. Complete existing instrumental excerpt retained: first16 bars plus4-beat preparation for social, first8 bars for community; later full-song sections are not appended. Community lacks two separate written attacks: bar5 at1beat D5 and bar6 at0.5beat A4. Add those attacks and restore exact durations, including source bar6G4 shortened to quarter and source ending cut to2.364beats. Social original timings approximate a128-BPM performance imported under120-BPM metadata and drift from notation. Restore exact printed rhythms at the independently printed128 tempo; do not treat imported120 as authoritative written tempo. Social ends at bar16 finalD5 half note; its printed tie continues into bar17 outside source. Retain the selected excerpt endpoint explicitly instead of inventing absent continuation. Use nominal written durations with10ms game-practice release gap; original gates remain in evidence, not presented as faithful instrumental articulation. Root重看整页与两个放大图，另录绝对MIDI及时值全部16小节99音，与代理完整数值一致；非盲复读，不声称盲审。完整重解码原文件并核对每个原音、休止、输出起点时值。 纠正候选关于performance的措辞：social约0.9375倍率只是原数值与印谱时值比，不是演奏或录音实测。128 BPM仅以原谱明确印刷为依据。 两份均保留完整现有前奏片段；community两缺失起音补在m5拍1与m6拍0.5；social四拍准备休止保留，m16末D5二拍截取跨界tie片段，未补源中没有的m17。无真人试听、录音对齐或游戏验证。
